symbolKind.file: Kind of a project symbol, shown as a lowercase noun in a hover card
symbolKind.section: Kind of a project symbol: a sectioning command
symbolKind.label: Kind of a project symbol: a \label target
symbolKind.anchor: Kind of a project symbol: a Typst label target
symbolKind.macro: Kind of a project symbol: a user-defined command
symbolKind.environment: Kind of a project symbol: a user-defined environment
symbolKind.glossary: Kind of a project symbol: a glossary entry
symbolKind.bibentry: Kind of a project symbol: a bibliography entry
symbolKind.reference: Kind of a project symbol: a \ref use
symbolKind.citation: Kind of a project symbol: a \cite use
symbolKind.include: Kind of a project symbol: an \include or \input
symbolKind.import: Kind of a project symbol: a Typst import
symbolKind.link: Kind of a project symbol: a URL
symbolKind.asset: Kind of a project symbol: an image or PDF the document includes
symbolKind.bibliography: Kind of a project symbol: a bibliography file reference

hover.figure: Hover card title over an included image; {{name}} is the file name
hover.definition: Hover card title: the symbol kind followed by its name
hover.auxNumber: Number and page the last compile assigned to this label
hover.duplicateDetail_other: F12 is a keyboard shortcut and stays verbatim

diagnostics.finding: Joins a preflight finding's title and its detail into one sentence
diagnostics.typstLabelOrCitation: Typst @foo can be either a label or a citation, so the diagnostic names both
diagnostics.citation: Noun used in a diagnostic about a \cite
diagnostics.reference: Noun used in a diagnostic about a \ref
diagnostics.unresolved: {{noun}} arrives already lowercased for mid-sentence use

completion.standardEnvironment: Completion detail for an environment built into LaTeX rather than defined in the project
completion.latexPackage: Completion detail shown when CTAN has no description for the package
completion.latexDocumentClass: Completion detail shown when CTAN has no description for the class
completion.packageCommand: Completion detail for a command a package provides
completion.packageOption: Completion detail for one option of a package; {{name}} is the package name
completion.keyvalKey: Completion detail for a key of a key-value command; {{command}} is the command name without its backslash
completion.duplicateCount: Chip saying the same name is defined more than once
completion.duplicateIndex: Chip saying which of several entries with the same key this one is

references.updating: Shown when a navigation action runs before the project analysis finished
references.definitionsFor: Title of the results panel listing every definition of a name
references.referencesTo: Title of the results panel listing every use of a definition

languageService.setUp: Starts downloading and installing the language server
languageService.retry: Tries to start the language server again
languageService.install: Button that downloads and installs the language server
languageService.destination: Filesystem path the language server is installed to
languageService.verification: Heading for the checksum verification note

reasons.backpressure: Status line: the server refused work because it was overloaded
reasons.beingInstalled: Status line shown while the download and install run
reasons.couldNotSynchronize: Status line, not a full sentence, shown in the startup checklist
reasons.exitedRestartScheduled: {{attempt}} is the restart attempt number, such as 1 or 2
reasons.installingPinned: {{kind}} is the server name, texlab or tinymist, and stays verbatim
reasons.internal: Status line for an unclassified failure inside the native worker
reasons.notInstalled: {{kind}} is the server name and stays verbatim; {{version}} is its version number
reasons.starting: Per-feature status shown while the server is launching
reasons.versionMismatch: {{kind}} is the server name and stays verbatim; {{expected}} and {{reported}} are version numbers

reasons.diagnosticsNotRun: Status line, not a full sentence, shown when no diagnostics exist yet
reasons.documentClosed: Status line, not a full sentence, explaining why a result was dropped
reasons.documentVersionNotTracked: Status line, not a full sentence, shown when a request names an unknown document
reasons.featureNotAdvertised: {{feature}} is an LSP capability name such as hover or completion and stays verbatim
reasons.identityMismatch: Status line, not a full sentence, shown when a result arrives for an older project revision
reasons.languageServiceUnavailable: Status line, not a full sentence, shown when the server is down
reasons.noProject: Status line, not a full sentence, shown when no project is open
reasons.supportedNotRun: Status line: the feature is available but nothing has requested it yet
